nodes.scope:
Create proposed tests/install-parent-admission.py, using the actual initialize_staging()/trusted_parent() source and native Linux stat/id/mktemp/filesystem. Proposed CLI: python3 tests/install-parent-admission.py --source install.sh --consumer-uid 1000 --foreign-uid 0 --out evidence/R0015/parent-admission. Acquisition prerequisite is a disposable existing privileged Linux/container fixture with root or CAP_SETUID plus capability to assign fixture directory UID; do not create/change host accounts or the real HOME. Record actual IDs, filesystem type/mount, directory dev/inode/UID/mode and source hash.

Put root-owned0755 reachable nonsymlink ancestors inside the isolated fixture. Give the subject UID1000 a TMPDIR it owns, mode0700. Negative HOME is foreign UID0 mode0755: physically reachable, not group/world writable, no symlink and not a writable-mode negative. Run actual initializer in a fresh process after dropping to UID1000; it must fail the final HOME ownership admission (Use a private, owned staging parent), nonzero before any mktemp/acquisition/output effect, with unchanged outside/victim/subject sentinels. Matched positive has identical ancestors/mode0755 but HOME UID1000: initializer succeeds and creates distinct private0700 scratch/retained roots owned by1000; scratch cleanup and retained consumption work. Root-owned ancestors are permitted by the real source, so the negative isolates the final retained-parent self-ownership predicate rather than ancestor/writable rejection. Optional foreign UID65534 case separately characterizes ancestor-owner rejection; do not conflate it with this required negative. Instrument/log native mktemp delegations and post-state separately. For the parse-valid mutant remove only terminal HOME self-owner admission and call the actual trusted_parent "$HOME" home helper: the mutant must return that hostile parent, failing the admission oracle. Do not require a later mktemp to succeed in UID0/mode0755 HOME; native write permission can reject it downstream and would mask the missing admission if exit alone were used. The unchanged full initializer negative still proves refusal before any effect. Preserve the healthy unchanged positive. Existing49-operation peer-DAC evidence remains accepted for created-root isolation and is not rerun or mislabeled parent admission.

documentationFacts.section: README / One-line install / manual bundle lifetime
documentationFacts.fact: Normal Bash staging creates separate TMPDIR/salah-widget-download.XXXXXXXX scratch and HOME/salah-widget-install.XXXXXXXX retained bundle. Keep the unpacked extension directory while installed. After manual import/installation, preset/XPI files may be removed manually if no longer needed; no automated removal is promised.

Successful and explicitly partial retained manual bundles survive exit/failure/interrupt; consult retained paths and completion state. Cleanup removes only the unchanged verified scratch, not the retained bundle or preexisting user files.

Valid same-attempt asset reuse avoids another fetch and returns exact existing path. Next invocation creates a new private scratch; older shared caches/retained manual bundles are not admitted as trusted cross-run cache.

affectedRegressionSet: Foreign-UID non-writable HOME admission plus matched positive and owner-gate mutant
Unchanged Linux ZIP/peerDAC49/cache/input and Windows/runtime/V1 proofs reused
reuseRules: Reuse an accepted row only with unchanged relevant source bytes, interface, test inputs and native environment assumptions; bind them in a reuse manifest. A new source/tree digest alone is insufficient. Changing README does not invalidate unchanged native installer bytes.

Keep historical native execution historical. Native Linux Bash5.2.21, Windows PowerShell5.1.26100.9444 and PowerShell7.6.6 receipts are not fresh reruns or Apple proof. No disabled-builtin, PLATFORM=mac, VM, Linux/GNU utility or Windows-filesystem substitution closes an actual Apple cell.

The current 16-case public rollout and 139-file binding establish the delivered baseline. They do not establish future changed documentation, diagnostic-specific overlay/reduced-motion cases, or every backlog obligation.

If an installer/runtime/serializer changes, invalidate the affected call-chain and mutant receipts and rerun only the corresponding necessary native/consumer gates after authorization. A doc-only patch reuses unchanged parser/selector/staging/currentness interfaces.

Use foreign UID0/mode0755 final HOME predicate, with root ancestors allowed, to isolate wrong ownership; writable /tmp is insufficient.
Privileged disposable fixture access is an acquisition prerequisite, not a policy/owner conflict or new host account requirement.
No required full installer/runtime rewrite; preserve native guard security and derive a narrow repair only from a new valid-parent counterexample.
